current_answer: Choose a ready-made frontend skill for a specific task, not by its name or popularity. If an existing design system governs the screen, first give the agent its real components, tokens, route, and states; a generic visual-direction skill may add unwanted choices. A source-derived design-system skill is a separate creation project, not a seventeenth ready-made listing. For a consequential task, compare the same project with a careful no-skill brief and the candidate skill, then inspect function and the rendered result. None of our sixteen listings has a pool-run outcome comparison.
